cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：可靠的
cards.example_en: My old car isn't very reliable.

cards.example_en: I was unable to finish the exam before the bell.

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: Quick action stopped the fire in the school kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 迅速行动扑灭了学校厨房里的火。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：男演员
cards.example_en: The actor bowed after the school play ended.
cards.example_zh: 校园剧结束时，男演员鞠了一躬。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：女演员
cards.example_en: The actress forgot her line and laughed with us.
cards.example_zh: 女演员忘了台词，跟着我们一起笑了。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: A family discussion ended with pizza instead of leftover stew.
cards.example_zh: 家里讨论到最后，决定吃披萨，不吃剩炖菜。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：表演；表现
cards.example_en: The drama club will perform a short play on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社星期五将表演一个短剧。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：表演；表现
cards.example_en: Her performance in the play was excellent.
cards.example_zh: 她在剧中的表现非常出色。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: Loud music from next door made it hard to do homework.
cards.example_zh: 隔壁的音乐声很大，作业很难写下去。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：高兴的
cards.example_en: Mum was pleased with my improved maths score.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈对我提高后的数学成绩很高兴。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: A storm warning told us to stay indoors after lunch.

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: My aunt's wedding will be in a garden this June.
cards.example_zh: 我阿姨的婚礼今年六月将在一座花园里举行。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：双语的
cards.example_en: The bilingual menu lists dishes in both Chinese and English.
cards.example_zh: 双语菜单用中文和英文列出菜品。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: The town lantern festival lit the river for three nights.
cards.example_zh: 镇上的灯节把河面照亮了三个晚上。
